model_annotation: The plot displays two separate line charts comparing the training rewards of two algorithms, "Llama-On-Policy" and "Llama-LUFFY", across different training sets: "Easy Training Set" and "Hard Training Set". Both charts share identical axes: the x-axis is labeled "Steps" and ranges from 0 to 500 on a linear scale with tick marks at intervals of 100; the y-axis is labeled "Training Rewards" and ranges from 0.0 to 0.4 (for the top chart) or 0.0 to 0.2 (for the bottom chart), also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 0.1. In the top chart, labeled "Easy Training Set", the blue line ("Llama-On-Policy-Easy") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.38 by step 500, while the red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Easy") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.40 by step 500. In the bottom chart, labeled "Hard Training Set", the blue line ("Llama-On-Policy-Hard") starts near 0.0 and remains near 0.0 throughout, while the red line ("Llama-LUFFY-Hard") starts near 0.0 and rises to approximately 0.20 by step 500.
